option_why.D: ✓ Angulation ไฟล์วงด้วย

questions.stem: A 45-year-old patient presents with low back pain radiating to the lateral aspect of the leg and dorsum of the foot. Physical examination reveals weakness of dorsiflexion of the great toe and decreased sensation over the dorsum of the foot. Which is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: ปวดหลังร้าวขาด้านข้างและหลังเท้า great toe dorsiflexion อ่อน คือ herniated L4–L5 (C ไฟล์วงด้วย)
questions.key_concept:
• L5 radiculopathy
• สรุป: ปวดหลังร้าวขาด้านข้างและหลังเท้า great toe dorsiflexion อ่อน คือ herniated L4–L5 (C ไฟล์วง

option_why.C: ✓ Scoliosis ไฟล์วงด้วย

questions.stem: A 62-year-old man presents with severe lower back pain, urinary retention, decreased anal sphincter tone, saddle anesthesia, and asymmetric weakness in both legs. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: ปวดหลัง ปัสสาวะคั่ง saddle anesthesia = cauda equina syndrome
questions.key_concept:
• Cauda equina
• สรุป: ปวดหลัง ปัสสาวะคั่ง saddle anesthesia = cauda equina syndrome

questions.stem: An elderly woman sustains a distal radius fracture and is treated with a cast. Based on the phase of bone healing, when should the cast usually be removed?
questions.explanation: ถอดเฝือก distal radius หลัง 6 สัปดาห์ hard callus
questions.key_concept:
• Hard callus 6 wk
• สรุป: ถอดเฝือก distal radius หลัง 6 สัปดาห์ hard callus

questions.stem: From the picture, which structure is most likely injured?
questions.explanation: นิ้วเหยียดไม่ได้ (mallet) คือ extensor digitorum tendon

• สรุป: นิ้วเหยียดไม่ได้ (mallet) คือ extensor digitorum tendon

questions.stem: A 40-year-old man goes out to socialize with friends. After a period of time, he suddenly passes out. Upon waking, he is unable to extend his wrist and has lost sensation over the dorsum of his hand. Which type of peripheral nerve injury is most likely responsible for his symptoms?

options.D: Mixed peripheral injury of the radial nerve

questions.explanation: หมดสติจากเมาแล้วยกมือไม่ได้ คือ radial neurapraxia (B ไฟล์วงด้วย)
questions.key_concept:
• Saturday night palsy: neurapraxia
• สรุป: หมดสติจากเมาแล้วยกมือไม่ได้ คือ radial neurapraxia (B ไฟล์วงด้วย)

questions.stem: Which of the following processes is most important for axonal regeneration?

options.A: Schwann cells transform into repair cells
options.C: Retrograde signal to the nucleus to stimulate transcription factors
options.D: Development of a growth cone that helps direct axonal growth

questions.explanation: การงอกของ axon ต้องมี growth cone นำทาง (E ไฟล์วงด้วย)
questions.key_concept:
• Axon regeneration
• สรุป: การงอกของ axon ต้องมี growth cone นำทาง (E ไฟล์วงด้วย)

option_why.E: ✓ None ไฟล์วงด้วย

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct regarding secondary bone healing?

options.A: Bone resorption occurs through a cutting cone as the primary mechanism of fracture healing
options.B: The fracture is repaired directly through the cortex without callus formation
options.C: The bony fragments are perfectly stable with absolute stability
options.D: Relative stability with controlled micromovement and partial weight-bearing
options.E: The healing process is initiated primarily by fibroblast proliferation

questions.explanation: Secondary healing: relative stability กับ micromovement
questions.key_concept:
• Secondary: callus
• สรุป: Secondary healing: relative stability กับ micromovement

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct sequence of peripheral nerve repair after injury?
questions.explanation: ลำดับ: Wallerian degeneration → regeneration (E ไฟล์วงด้วย)
questions.key_concept:
• Wallerian first
• สรุป: ลำดับ: Wallerian degeneration → regeneration (E ไฟล์วงด้วย)

option_why.E: ✓ ไฟล์วงด้วย

questions.stem: Which patient is least likely to achieve proper bone healing after a fracture?

options.A: A 30-year-old female athlete with a fatigue fracture who maintains a healthy diet
options.B: A 55-year-old man with a history of osteoporosis who recently sustained a closed hip fracture
options.C: A 6-year-old boy with a severe open fracture of the left tibia associated with extensive soft tissue injury
options.D: A 3-year-old girl with a closed fracture of the left humerus and a history of chronic osteomyelitis
options.E: A 70-year-old man with diabetes who has an open fracture of the femur associated with vascular injury

questions.explanation: DM คุมไม่ดี open fracture หายยากสุด
questions.key_concept:

questions.stem: Which of the following enzymes is responsible for the metabolism of succinylcholine, and a deficiency of this enzyme can result in prolonged paralysis after administration of the drug?
questions.explanation: Succinylcholine ถูกย่อยโดย plasma cholinesterase
questions.key_concept:
• SCh: BChE
• สรุป: Succinylcholine ถูกย่อยโดย plasma cholinesterase

questions.stem: A male patient undergoing surgery for prostate cancer receives succinylcholine and halothane during general anesthesia. He subsequently develops severe muscle rigidity, rapidly increasing body temperature, tachycardia, and other signs of a serious adverse reaction. The anesthetic agents are discontinued, and an antidote is administered. What is the mechanism of action of the antidote?

options.A: Increase calcium release from the sarcoplasmic reticulum
options.C: Inhibit calcium ion (Ca2+) release from the sarcoplasmic reticulum
options.D: Block acetylcholine receptors at the neuromuscular junction

questions.explanation: Malignant hyperthermia: dantrolene ยับยั้ง Ca release จาก SR (ตัวเลือก C)
questions.key_concept:
• Dantrolene: RyR1 blocker
• สรุป: Malignant hyperthermia: dantrolene ยับยั้ง Ca release จาก SR (ตัวเลือก C)

option_why.B: Activate RyR1 คือ สาเหตุ

questions.stem: Which of the following drugs is commonly used as a neuromuscular blocking agent to produce rapid skeletal muscle relaxation during general anesthesia?
questions.explanation: Succinylcholine ใช้เพื่อ rapid relaxation
questions.key_concept:
• SCh: rapid onset
• สรุป: Succinylcholine ใช้เพื่อ rapid relaxation

option_why.C: Rocuronium ก็เร็วแต่ไม่เท่า

questions.stem: A 56-year-old patient with COPD and a history of heavy smoking is scheduled for surgery. A non-depolarizing neuromuscular blocking agent is required for muscle relaxation during anesthesia. Which of the following drugs should be avoided?
questions.explanation: COPD ใช้ atracurium (Hofmann) (B ไฟล์วงด้วย)

option_why.B: ✓ Pancuronium ไฟล์วงด้วย

questions.stem: An 80-year-old man with a history of ischemic stroke has been taking low-dose aspirin for secondary prevention for several years. questions.stem: A patient presents with an acetaminophen overdose. Which is the appropriate antidote?

questions.stem: A child presents with fever and generalized muscle aches due to influenza infection. Which of the following medications is the most appropriate for symptomatic treatment?
